text: In Genesis 22 the three days’ journey has the nature of a suspended sentence. To the outward eye nothing passes; to the meaning of the history all is passing. Obedience abides with horror, and neither is permitted to master the other. Faith, therefore, is given in the form of an ordered relation, and is not chiefly feeling. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with scrupulous care; the instruments appear before the act.
